'''James Medlin''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[August 2000 Lakewood tournament]] on 18 August 2000 with Endor Troopers, according to Douglas Harvilla's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1145">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-08-19-lakewood-wa-8-18-00d1145/ lakewood-wa-8-18-00], DeckTech (Douglas "Douglas" Harvilla, 19 August 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-08-19-lakewood-wa-8-18-00d1145/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
